summary: Wife of Giovanni Antonio Colosimo and mother of Candida, Matteo Nunziato and Giovanna Santa; John's 7th-great-grandmother.
bio: Fenice Rizulo, whose surname is also written Ripolo, was the wife of Giovanni Antonio Colosimo. Their children were Candida, born in 1715, Matteo Nunziato, born in 1718, and Giovanna Santa, born in 1721. She is John's 7th-great-grandmother.
